localizedValues.name: S1-Torpedo Warehouse Shelter
localizedValues.description:
Torpedo Warehouse Shelter. No amplified devices, No kegs, water balloons, egg tosses or straw bales. Check out no later than 1 hour before dusk. All events that have professional photography are required to have a film permit.
No driving or backing up to building with motor vehicles. Parking is located in the day use area and is shared with other shelters and day use visitors. Carpooling is recommended.

localizedValues.name: S2-Picnic Shelter Building 4
localizedValues.description:
Picnic Shelter #1. No amplified devises. No kegs. No water balloons, eggtosses or straw bales. Check out no later than 1 hour before dusk.
No motor vehicle access to picnic shelter. Parking is located in the day use area and is shared with other shelters and day use visitors. Carpooling is recommended.

localizedValues.name: S3-Picnic Shelter Building 3
localizedValues.description:
Picnic Shelter #2. No amplified devises. No kegs. No water balloons, eggtosses or straw bales. Check out no later than 1 hour before dusk.
No motor vehicle access to picnic shelter. Parking is located in the day use area and is shared with other shelters and day use visitors. Carpooling is recommended.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description: Group Camp. Overnight reservations only. Not reservable as a day use facility. G1 includes up to 24 parking spots for RVs/trailers depending on equipment size (12 with electric hook-ups) and an area for tents.
